lines.zh: 海岸水浅，我沿着沙线慢慢游。
lines.en: The coast is shallow; I swim along the sand line.

lines.zh: 涨潮时我们往岸上挪一点。
lines.en: At high tide we nudge a little closer to shore.

lines.zh: 我跟在同伴后面，保持半条身长。
lines.en: I follow my companions, keeping half a body length.

lines.zh: 三到五条一群，不多不少。
lines.en: Three to five in a school, no more, no less.

lines.zh: 我身上有竖纹，游起来像水草。
lines.en: My stripes sway as I swim, like water weeds.

lines.zh: 只在四十格以上的水域，我自在。
lines.en: I am at ease only above height forty.

lines.zh: 六十八厘米，在浅海里很灵活。
lines.en: Sixty-eight centimetres is nimble in the shallows.

lines.zh: 记录里那条一百二十五厘米的，是传说。
lines.en: The one hundred and twenty-five centimetre record is legend.

lines.zh: 我几乎贴着沙底走，躲开大鱼。
lines.en: I hug the sandy floor to avoid bigger fish.

lines.zh: 受惊时我们散开，又很快聚拢。
lines.en: Startled, we scatter, then gather again quickly.

lines.zh: 我摆尾的节奏，跟潮水一样。
lines.en: My tail beats in time with the tide.

lines.zh: 一条船经过，我往下压了压。
lines.en: A boat passes and I press a little lower.

lines.zh: 群游的时候，影子是一片一片的。
lines.en: In a school our shadows come in patches.

lines.zh: 我不去深海，那儿太冷清。
lines.en: I keep to the coast; the deep is too empty.

lines.zh: 我贴着红树的根游过浅滩。
lines.en: I skim the mangrove roots across the shallows.

lines.zh: 潮水退的时候，我往深处退。
lines.en: As the tide drops, I back into deeper water.

lines.zh: 沙脊上的光影，正好遮住我。
lines.en: The light and shade on the sand ridge hides me.

lines.zh: 我跟在前面那条的尾后。
lines.en: I follow behind the tail of the one ahead.

lines.zh: 我停在水草边，一动不动。
lines.en: I hover by the weeds, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我等着它回来。
lines.en: The tide went out; I wait for its return.

lines.zh: 沙粒在水底打着旋，我看着。
lines.en: Sand grains swirl below and I watch them.

lines.zh: 同伴在右边，我知道它在。
lines.en: My companion is to my right; I know it.

lines.zh: 我只有四点血，所以很小心。
lines.en: Four points of health is why I am careful.

lines.zh: 一只海龟游过，我让开一点。
lines.en: A turtle passes and I give it room.

lines.zh: 我们三五条一群，贴着海岸游。
lines.en: We swim the coast three to five strong.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水把食物推过来。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to push food my way.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我会数气泡。
lines.en: When it is quiet, I count bubbles.

lines.zh: 你们管我叫锯盖鱼，我记住了。
lines.en: You call me snook; I have remembered it.

lines.zh: 一整片浅滩，够我们分。
lines.en: One shallow flat is enough for all of us.

lines.zh: 我摆一下鳍，水纹就散了。
lines.en: One flick of my fin breaks the ripples.

lines.zh: 岸上有人走，我听得到。
lines.en: Someone walks the shore; I can hear them.

lines.zh: 我不爱争，躲开就是了。
lines.en: I do not like to fight; I simply move aside.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，影子里有我。
lines.en: You stand ashore, and your shadow holds me.

lines.zh: 我贴着岸边，追着你的影子游。
lines.en: I hug the shoreline, swimming after your shadow.

lines.zh: 你的鱼竿我认得，别以为我傻。
lines.en: I know that rod of yours; do not think I am foolish.

lines.zh: 我侧着身，让你看我那几道竖纹。
lines.en: I turn sideways to show you my stripes.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我也没游远。
lines.en: You crouch down, and I do not swim off.

lines.zh: 我们隔着水面，互相打量。
lines.en: We size each other up through the water's skin.

lines.zh: 你手里那条虫，抖得厉害。
lines.en: That worm in your hand is shaking badly.

lines.zh: 你的鱼竿影子落进水里了。
lines.en: Your rod's shadow just fell across the water.

lines.zh: 你靠近时，我数了你的步子。
lines.en: As you came closer, I counted your steps.

lines.zh: 看够了吗？我要回去群游了。
lines.en: Seen enough? I am going back to my school.

lines.zh: 你踩到我了，我的尾巴。
lines.en: You stepped on me, on my tail.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，我游得还是快。
lines.en: It hurts, but I still swim fast.

lines.zh: 我掉了一片鳞，就在沙上。
lines.en: I lost a scale; it lies on the sand.

lines.zh: 四点血真的很薄。
lines.en: Four health is genuinely thin.

lines.zh: 我往水草里钻，你别追。
lines.en: I dive into the weeds; do not follow.

lines.zh: 这一竿力气不小，我记住。
lines.en: That strike had force; I will remember it.

lines.zh: 群里的同伴散了，我也要跑。
lines.en: The school scattered; I should run too.

lines.zh: 血把水染浑了，看不清。
lines.en: Blood clouds the water; I cannot see.

lines.zh: 别打头，我脑袋很软。
lines.en: Not the head, my skull is soft.

lines.zh: 我认输了，放我回岸。
lines.en: I yield; let me back to the shallows.

lines.zh: 你挂的饵在动，很可疑。
lines.en: The bait you hung is moving; that is suspicious.

lines.zh: 虫子的味道顺着水流过来了。
lines.en: The smell of the worm drifts downstream to me.

lines.zh: 我绕着饵转半圈，先看看。
lines.en: I circle the bait halfway and take a look.

lines.zh: 我拉力只有零点四五，不挣扎。
lines.en: My pull is point four five; I give in easily.

lines.zh: 上钩后我游速一点一，还行。
lines.en: Hooked, I swim at one point one, not bad.

lines.zh: 这条饵要是真的，我就咬。
lines.en: If that bait is real, I am biting it.

lines.zh: 别晃竿，我盯着鱼线看呢。
lines.en: Stop jiggling the rod; I am watching the line.

lines.zh: 三到五条同类都在等，你先给我。
lines.en: Three to five of us are waiting; pick me first.

lines.zh: 我承认，我饿了很久了。
lines.en: I admit it, I have been hungry for a while.

lines.zh: 咬钩之前，我会先碰一下。
lines.en: Before biting, I will bump it once.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩进水里，我撞了上去。
lines.en: Your foot entered the water and I bumped it.

lines.zh: 我碰到你的小腿，一滑就过。
lines.en: I graze your shin and slip right past.

lines.zh: 船底擦过我的背，粗糙得很。
lines.en: The boat's hull scrapes my back, rough and cold.

lines.zh: 群游时我们互撞，是打招呼。
lines.en: In a school, bumping is how we greet.

lines.zh: 我身体软，撞上去不疼。
lines.en: My body is soft; bumping me does not hurt.

lines.zh: 你一退，水花全扑到我脸上。
lines.en: You step back and the splash hits my face.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的腿转，找缝隙钻。
lines.en: I circle your legs, looking for a gap.

lines.zh: 这一下我撞歪了，尾巴还在摆。
lines.en: I bump off course, tail still beating.

lines.zh: 别在水里跺脚，我们会被吓散。
lines.en: Do not stomp in the water; we will scatter.

lines.zh: 我不过去，你那儿太挤了。
lines.en: I will not go there; it is too crowded.

lines.zh: 开春的浅滩，我们成对游。
lines.en: In spring shallows we swim in pairs.

lines.zh: 她身上的竖纹比我深一点。
lines.en: Her stripes run a shade darker than mine.

lines.zh: 我们把卵撒在水草之间。
lines.en: We scatter our eggs among the water weeds.

lines.zh: 交配时我们并排，尾鳍贴着。
lines.en: We mate side by side, tail fins touching.

lines.zh: 群里的同伴替我们挡着大鱼。
lines.en: The school shields us from bigger fish.

lines.zh: 我绕着她转三圈，才靠近。
lines.en: I circle her three times before drawing close.

lines.zh: 水温刚好，孩子们会活下来。
lines.en: The water is warm; our young will survive.

lines.zh: 她走了，我还留在浅滩上。
lines.en: She left, and I stayed on the shallow flat.

lines.zh: 六十八厘米的我，算不上漂亮。
lines.en: At sixty-eight centimetres, I am no beauty.

lines.zh: 这不过是鱼的本分。
lines.en: This is nothing more than a fish's duty.

lines.zh: 水底有块掉下来的面包，我叼走。
lines.en: A dropped piece of bread sinks; I take it.

lines.zh: 你失手掉的虫子，我捡到了。
lines.en: You dropped a worm; I found it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴推了推那块碎石。
lines.en: I nudge the loose gravel with my mouth.

lines.zh: 亮东西我不碰，太像钩。
lines.en: I avoid shiny things; they look like hooks.

lines.zh: 水草缠住的东西，我拖出来。
lines.en: I pull loose whatever the weeds have snagged.

lines.zh: 这枚鳞片是我自己的，掉了。
lines.en: This scale is mine; it came off.

lines.zh: 我把食物含住，游回群里。
lines.en: I hold the food and swim back to the school.

lines.zh: 沉底的果子，我尝了一口。
lines.en: A sunken berry, I took a single taste.

lines.zh: 太重的东西，我拖不动。
lines.en: Anything too heavy, I cannot drag.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西，我会分给同伴。
lines.en: What I find, I share with my companions.

lines.zh: 水面上有动静，我抬头了。
lines.en: Something moves on the surface; I look up.

lines.zh: 那不是同类，我确定了。
lines.en: That is not one of us; I am certain.

lines.zh: 你踩水的声音太明显。
lines.en: The sound of your wading is too obvious.

lines.zh: 我把目标定在你脚边。
lines.en: I fix my aim on the water by your feet.

lines.zh: 四点血的我，也敢追。
lines.en: With four health, I still dare to chase.

lines.zh: 群里的伙伴跟着我一起转头。
lines.en: My schoolmates turn with me as one.

lines.zh: 不是要咬你，是想看清。
lines.en: I do not mean to bite, only to look.

lines.zh: 这影子在水里晃，我得确认。
lines.en: That shadow sways in the water; I must check.

lines.zh: 选定了，就朝那边游。
lines.en: Decided, I swim straight for it.

lines.zh: 你们人多，我只盯一个。
lines.en: You are many; I watch only one.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的脚踝转了两圈。
lines.en: I circle your ankle twice.

lines.zh: 我这群鱼还缺一个位置。
lines.en: My school still has room for one more.

lines.zh: 我不加速，我等你低头。
lines.en: I will not speed up; I wait for you to look down.

lines.zh: 浅滩就这么大，你躲不开。
lines.en: The flat is only so large; you cannot hide.

lines.zh: 同伴在我身后排成一线。
lines.en: My companions line up behind me.

lines.zh: 潮水在退，你的机会也在退。
lines.en: The tide is going out. So is your chance.

lines.zh: 我把你往礁石那边引。
lines.en: I steer you toward the rocks.

lines.zh: 近了，我已经能看见你的鞋。
lines.en: Closer now; I can see your shoes.

lines.zh: 别急着上岸，再待一会儿。
lines.en: Do not rush ashore; stay a little longer.

lines.zh: 追到最后，我只是想看看。
lines.en: In the end, I only wanted a look.

lines.zh: 我咬了你的脚趾，很轻。
lines.en: I nip your toe, very lightly.

lines.zh: 这一口不疼，只是想让你走。
lines.en: This bite does not hurt; I just want you gone.

lines.zh: 你抬脚，水花打了我一身。
lines.en: You lift your foot and the splash soaks me.

lines.zh: 我的牙小，咬不穿靴子。
lines.en: My teeth are small; they cannot pierce boots.

lines.zh: 群里的鱼一起啄，你才觉得痒。
lines.en: When the whole school pecks, then you feel it.

lines.zh: 我扯了一下鱼线，然后松口。
lines.en: I tug the line once, then let go.

lines.zh: 四点血的我，打不过你。
lines.en: With four health, I cannot beat you.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进来，我会当成食物。
lines.en: Do not put your hand in; I may take it for food.

lines.zh: 这一撞是警告，不是进攻。
lines.en: That bump was a warning, not an attack.

lines.zh: 我退了，浅滩还是我的。
lines.en: I retreat, but the flat is still mine.

lines.zh: 潮水把我送到这片浅滩。
lines.en: The tide carried me onto this shallow flat.

lines.zh: 三到五条，我们一起来的。
lines.en: Three to five of us arrived together.

lines.zh: 这里离岸不远，水也够深。
lines.en: It is near shore, and the water is deep enough.

lines.zh: 四十格以上的地方，正合适。
lines.en: Above height forty, exactly right.

lines.zh: 我从鱼群里分出来，算新的。
lines.en: I split off from the school; I am new here.

lines.zh: 水草边有空位，我占了。
lines.en: There was room by the weeds; I took it.

lines.zh: 常见得很，你不用惊讶。
lines.en: I am common enough; no need to be surprised.

lines.zh: 第一条同伴先到，我跟着。
lines.en: The first companion came; I followed.

lines.zh: 我出生时，潮水刚涨。
lines.en: I was born just as the tide came in.

lines.zh: 这片海我熟，别担心。
lines.en: I know this coast well; do not worry.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我躲到深处。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface; I sink deeper.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，砸进浅滩。
lines.en: I drop from above and hit the shallows.

lines.zh: 水是我的家，淹不死我。
lines.en: Water is my home; it cannot drown me.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我被掀了出去。
lines.en: The water bursts and I am thrown clear.

lines.zh: 箭射进水里，偏了。
lines.en: The arrow enters the water and goes wide.

lines.zh: 魔法让水变味了，我游开。
lines.en: Magic sours the water; I swim away.

lines.zh: 饿太久，我连沙都想咬。
lines.en: Starving this long, I would bite sand.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅滩，整片水都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the flat and the water glows.

lines.zh: 下面是虚空，我不敢再往下。
lines.en: The void is below; I will not go deeper.
